observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black mirrorless camera with 'Z 9' visible on the top right and an off LCD screen.
Photo 1 shows the top-left and front with 'Nikon' on the pentaprism, 'Z 9' on the right, mode dial, and body cap on the lens mount.
Photo 2 shows a top-down view with 'Z 9' and 'Nikon' visible, hot shoe, and top control buttons.
All three photos carry the watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DANIEL OYENIYI'.
No lens is attached in any photo; the camera appears to be body only.

claims.evidence: Photos show external appearance only; function cannot be verified remotely
Exterior looks clean in photos but sensor, mount, and internal cleanliness cannot be confirmed

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function (shutter, sensor, screen, buttons)
risks.proof: Video of camera turning on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or computer

risks.risk: LCD screen or electronic viewfinder damage not visible with screen off
risks.proof: Close-up photo of screen and EVF with light reflecting off the surface

risks.risk: Lens mount or sensor damage hidden by body cap
risks.proof: Photo of lens mount and sensor with body cap removed

risks.risk: Missing battery, charger, strap, box, or other accessories

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing the image
Close-up of LCD screen and electronic viewfinder
Photo of lens mount and sensor with body cap removed
response.reason: The camera is identifiable as a Nikon Z9 from the logos in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working body only pending proof of function.
